entries.title: Post to Douyin
entries.subtitle: Pick a video, write a caption, set a time

opening_card.text: Which one goes to Douyin? Pick from what you made recently, or upload from your album.
I'll check the plays, likes, comments and completion rate of each video on your Douyin over the last 7 days, then tell you what to make next.
